title: Virk advises the Galileo Project and the Sol Project
summary: Rizwan Virk tells of Virk advises the Galileo Project and the Sol Project, about 2020s at Galileo Project; Sol Project at Stanford, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Galileo Project; Sol Project at Stanford

tellings.quote: I'm I'm an advisor to the Galileo Project and peripherally involved with the Sol Project as well at Stanford.

plain: Rizwan Virk, a computer scientist linked to MIT who argues that we may live inside a simulation, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in the 2020s he has been an advisor to the Galileo Project, a scientific effort to study unexplained objects in the sky. He says he is also loosely involved with the Sol Project at Stanford University, another group looking into the same questions. He mentions it to show that serious academics are now openly working on these topics.
